nodes.description: Private owner address stored in Ownable; controls privileged functions via onlyOwner.
Mapping of account balances updated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Total token supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Public mint(address _to, uint256 _amount) restricted by onlyOwner; the only issuance entry point.
Access-control modifier that requires _owner == _msgSender() before executing the guarded body.
Caller address returned by _msgSender(); attacker controllable identity used in ownership checks.
Privileged token issuance that writes _totalSupply and _balances for an arbitrary address in mint/_mint.
Destination address parameter of mint, forwarded to _mint.
Amount parameter of mint, used in the arithmetic updates of _mint.
Internal mint that increments _totalSupply and the recipient balance.
Local variable in Ownable constructor holding _msgSender(), later assigned to _owner.
onlyOwner function that reassigns _owner to newOwner.
Internal transfer that debits sender and credits recipient balances.
onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0).
Internal approval that writes the _allowances mapping.
Nested mapping of owner to spender allowances.
Balance subtraction and addition performed in _transfer using SafeMath.

edges.reason: msg.sender (_msgSender) is compared against _owner inside the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner guards execution of mint, restricting who may issue tokens.
Parameter _to is passed into the mint function body.
Parameter _amount is passed into the mint function body.
mint delegates to the internal _mint function.
_to flows from mint into _mint as the credited account.
_amount flows from mint into _mint for supply and balance math.
_mint performs the privileged supply-increasing state update represented by the unsafe operation.
_amount drives the additions to _totalSupply and _balances in _mint.
_mint writes the recipient entry of the _balances mapping.
_mint increases _totalSupply via SafeMath addition.
_owner is the state read by the onlyOwner check.
_msgSender() returns msg.sender which is stored into the msgSender local variable.
Constructor assigns the deployer msgSender local variable to the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes a new value into _owner after the onlyOwner check.
renounceOwnership clears _owner to address(0) after the onlyOwner check.
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_transfer executes the balance sub/add arithmetic represented by the unsafe operation.
The _transfer arithmetic updates the _balances mapping.
